# AGENTS.md

## Architecture

- This is a **Gmeek**-powered GitHub Pages blog (generator: https://github.com/Meekdai/Gmeek).
- Blog posts are authored as **GitHub Issues**. The CI workflow watches `issues [opened, edited]` events and regenerates the site.
- There is **no local build toolchain**. `npm`, `pip`, etc. are not used locally. Generation only happens in CI.

## Auto-generated files (do not edit)

These are produced by the `Gmeek.yml` workflow and overwritten on every CI run:

- `docs/` — the deployed static site (HTML, RSS, postList.json, tag page)
- `backup/` — markdown snapshots of each post, generated by Gmeek
- `blogBase.json` — runtime blog state (post index, theme settings, etc.)

## Config files you can edit

- `config.json` — blog metadata: title, avatar, `GMEEK_VERSION` (pins the Gmeek generator version; `"last"` = latest tag), plugin scripts (`allHead`, `script`)
- `static/` — static assets (images, test images) referenced from posts

## Unrelated content

- `RESUME.md` / `RESUME.pdf` — personal resume, not part of the blog
- `workbench/` — scratch/draft directory, should be ignored

## Key conventions

- URL mode is **pinyin** (Chinese characters romanized in post URLs)
- Blog language: `"CN"` (i18n setting in `blogBase.json`)
- The CI workflow requires `GMEEK_VERSION` to match a valid Gmeek git tag
- CI commit user.email is read from `config.json`; make sure it contains an `"email"` field if you want auto-commits to associate correctly
- `.gitignore` excludes `RESUME.pdf` and `upload/Updates.md`
